svg.text: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE FLOWCHART — MULTICHAT AI (MULTI-AGENT CHAT & GROUP VOICE CALL)
Stack: Next.js 16.3 (App Router) | React 19 | Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite | Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL & Realtime | Web Speech API & PWA
• Live Gemini Voice Simulator (Empathy & Humor sliders)
• Strict Middleware Guard: protects Dashboard routes
• Explore Marketplace: Like, Clone & Publish AI Personas
• Instant Optimistic Bubble (opt- ID) + 3s Debounce Batch
• Web Speech Recognition (id-ID) realtime voice input
• Web Speech Synthesis with per-agent Pitch & Speed
• Anti-Echo Guard: auto-mutes mic while AI is speaking
• Mobile iOS/Android silent audio warmup on call start
• Prevents duplicate proactive triggers across open tabs
• Dynamic Agent Selection: @Mention match or context pick
• Cross-Room Memory Fetch: recalls last 15 messages across
other rooms involving the same user & AI agent
• Inter-AI Auto Reply: agents reply to each other in group
chats (capped at 4 turns to prevent infinite loops)
Defense: Dynamic confusion in character's exact slang/tone
• Smart Follow-Up: checks memory for past exams/interviews
• Zero Hallucination: casual check-in if no prior agenda exists
• Anti-Ghosting Guard: aborts if last room message was AI
with Memory Anti-Poisoning filter against old injections
• Adaptive Depth: 1-3 sentences casual vs deep coding/story
• Multi-bubble delimiter output (splits natural chat bubbles)
• Deduplicates opt- ID with DB UUID
Messages, User Personas, Guardrail Settings & Community Likes
[1-4] React 19 Optimistic UI + Web Speech Voice Call + PWA | [5-8] Inter-AI Group Routing + Dual-Layer Anti-Injection | [9] Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite | [10] Supabase Realtime & PostgreSQL
